notes: Crossed channel by 6 July. Ebeling had written Aug 1771 prompting the tour.
Arrived 15 July. 15 days between Brussels and Antwerp combined.
Arrived 6 August. Brief halts in intervening cities. Met Cannabich. APPROXIMATE departure.
Arrived 16 August. Louis Devisme (British plenipotentiary) 'of greatest assistance'. Got into Elector's library. Met Guadagni, Regina Mingotti, the Elector and his wife. APPROXIMATE departure.
Left Munich 24 Aug, travelled by 'great raft' down Isar and Danube to Vienna. Arrived 30 Aug.
Arrived 30 August, stayed 2 weeks, left 13 September. Aided by Lord Stormont (British ambassador). Met Metastasio, Hasse, and Gluck.
APPROXIMATE. En route Vienna to Berlin via Prague and Dresden.
APPROXIMATE. Met John Osborn (British Envoy). Osborn introduced Burney to the Elector.
Arrived 28 September. ~10 days. Met Marpurg ('another historian of music'). Concerts, churches, musical activity.
APPROXIMATE. Visit to Court of Frederick the Great. Frederick performed on flute — three concerts.
Arrived 9 October. Met CPE Bach ('many happy hours'), C.D. Ebeling (had corresponded since Aug 1771), Klopstock. Journal concluded at Rotterdam 20 October.
APPROXIMATE. Journal concluded here. Ship to Dover.
APPROXIMATE. Back in London early November 1772.
APPROXIMATE. Visited William Bewley immediately after return. Consulted on book manuscript.
